name: pmkusum_authenticate_farmer
description: Authenticates a farmer using Aadhaar and OTP. Requires no prior state. Validates that aadhaar_number is exactly 12 digits, mobile_number is 10 digits, and otp is 6 digits. Returns a session_token and farmer profile details. Does not submit an application or check eligibility. Fails if the OTP is incorrect or if the Aadhaar is not linked to the mobile number.

otp.description: 6-digit one time password sent to the mobile number [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer eligibility for PM-KUSUM components based on land and electricity status. Requires no prior state. Validates that scheme_component is a supported enum value and land_area_acres is greater than 0. Returns eligibility_status and maximum allowed pump capacity. Does not reserve subsidy or create an application. Fails if Component B is selected but electricity_connection_status is active_connection, or if land_area_acres is insufficient for Component A.

scheme_component.description: The PM-KUSUM scheme component to check eligibility for [EXACT]

electricity_connection_status.description: Current grid electricity connection status of the farmer [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_validate_land_records
description: Validates land ownership against state revenue records. Requires no prior state. Validates that state_code and district_code are valid integers and survey_number is alphanumeric. Returns verified land_area_acres, land_type, and owner name. Does not check scheme eligibility or submit applications. Fails if the survey_number is not found in state records or if the land is disputed.

name: pmkusum_get_pump_capacity_options
description: Retrieves allowed solar pump capacities based on water depth and land area. Requires no prior state. Validates that water_table_depth_meters is positive and land_area_acres is greater than 0. Returns a list of recommended pump_capacity_hp options. Does not check vendor availability or calculate subsidy. Fails if water_table_depth_meters exceeds the maximum supported depth for solar pumps.

water_table_depth_meters.description: Depth of the groundwater table in meters [EXACT]

land_area_acres.description: Total cultivable land area in acres [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates central, state, and farmer share for a given pump capacity and category. Requires no prior state. Validates that pump_capacity_hp, farmer_category, and state_region_category are valid enum values. Returns central_subsidy_amount, state_subsidy_amount, and farmer_share_amount. Does not disburse funds or lock in subsidy rates. Fails if pump_capacity_hp exceeds 7.5 HP for standard Component B without special state approval.

pump_capacity_hp.description: Capacity of the solar pump in horsepower [EXACT]

state_region_category.description: Geographical region category of the state [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_get_empanelled_vendors
description: Retrieves a list of MNRE-empanelled vendors for a specific district and pump capacity. Requires no prior state. Validates that state_code and district_code are valid and pump_capacity_hp is a supported enum. Returns a list of vendor_id, vendor_name, and contact details. Does not select a vendor or initiate contact. Fails if no vendors are currently empanelled for the specified district and capacity.

pump_capacity_hp.description: Capacity of the solar pump in horsepower [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_submit_application
description: Submits a new PM-KUSUM application for a solar pump or plant. Requires an authenticated session and eligibility_status: eligible. Validates that scheme_component is a valid enum and survey_number is provided. Returns application_id and application_status set to submitted. Does not select a vendor or pay the farmer share. Fails if a duplicate application exists for the same survey_number or if land ownership verification fails.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

scheme_component.description: The PM-KUSUM scheme component being applied for [EXACT]

survey_number.description: Verified land survey or khasra number [EXACT]

pump_capacity_hp.description: Requested capacity of the solar pump in horsepower [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_get_application_status
description: Retrieves the current status of a submitted PM-KUSUM application. Requires an existing application_id. Validates that application_id is a valid alphanumeric string. Returns application_status, vendor_selection_status, and installation_status. Does not modify the application or authenticate the user. Fails if the application_id does not exist in the system.

name: pmkusum_select_vendor
description: Confirms vendor selection for an approved PM-KUSUM application. Requires an authenticated session, application_status: approved, and vendor_selection_status: pending. Validates that application_id and vendor_id are valid strings. Returns updated vendor_selection_status as confirmed and estimated farmer_share_amount due. Does not process the farmer share payment or schedule installation. Fails if the vendor_id is not empanelled for the district or if the selection window has expired.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkusum_pay_farmer_share
description: Processes the farmer share payment for a sanctioned solar pump. Requires an authenticated session, vendor_selection_status: confirmed, and farmer_share_payment_status: pending. Validates that application_id is valid and payment_amount is greater than zero. Returns transaction_id and updated farmer_share_payment_status as paid. Does not disburse the government subsidy to the vendor. Fails if the payment_amount is incorrect or if the payment gateway times out.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

payment_amount.description: Exact farmer share amount to be paid [EXACT]

payment_method.description: Method of payment such as UPI, netbanking, or card [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_get_installation_schedule
description: Retrieves the installation schedule and assigned technician details. Requires an authenticated session, farmer_share_payment_status: paid, and installation_status: scheduled or in_progress. Validates that application_id is valid. Returns scheduled_date, technician_name, and technician_contact. Does not change the scheduled date or confirm installation completion. Fails if the installation_status is not_scheduled or if the vendor has not yet assigned a technician.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkusum_get_subsidy_disbursement_status
description: Tracks the disbursement status of central and state subsidies to the vendor. Requires an existing application_id and installation_status: completed. Validates that application_id is valid. Returns subsidy_disbursement_status, disbursed_amount, and disbursement_date. Does not initiate the disbursement or verify the physical installation. Fails if the installation_status is not completed or if the application_id is invalid.

name: pmkusum_report_pump_issue
description: Logs a maintenance or repair request for an installed solar pump. Requires an authenticated session and pump_operational_status: operational or faulty. Validates that application_id is valid and issue_description is at least 10 characters. Returns complaint_id and updated pump_operational_status as under_repair. Does not dispatch a technician immediately or process warranty claims. Fails if the pump is out of the 5-year comprehensive maintenance contract warranty period.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

issue_description.description: Detailed description of the pump malfunction or issue [SUBSTRING]

name: pmkusum_raise_grievance
description: Submits a formal grievance regarding the PM-KUSUM application or installation process. Requires an authenticated session and an existing application_id. Validates that grievance_category is a valid enum and grievance_remarks is not empty. Returns grievance_id and expected_resolution_date. Does not resolve the grievance or directly contact the vendor. Fails if a grievance of the same category is already open for the given application_id.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private application and subsidy data [TYPE_ONLY]

grievance_category.description: Category of the grievance being raised [EXACT]

name: pmkusum_track_grievance_status
description: Retrieves the current status and resolution remarks of a submitted grievance. Requires an existing grievance_id. Validates that grievance_id is a valid alphanumeric string. Returns grievance_status, resolution_remarks, and resolved_date. Does not escalate the grievance or modify its details. Fails if the grievance_id does not exist in the system.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted grievance [TYPE_ONLY]
